newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-HIH to buy Colonial's insurance unit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-HIH to buy Colonial's insurance unit.

text.p: Insurance group HIH Winterthur Ltd said on Wednesday it would buy all the shares in Colonial Mutual General Insurance Co Ltd, a unit of the unlisted Colonial Mutual group, for an undisclosed sum.
It said the acquisition and the formation of an alliance with the Colonial group would generate new premium in 1997 of A$80 million, growing to A$140 million within three years.
"HIH Winterthur Insurance today announced that it is acquiring a sizeable Australian insurance portfolio," it said.

"HIH Casualty and General Insurance Limited will acquire on a net asset basis all of the shares in Colonial Mutual General Insurance Company Limited (Colonial General) with effect from 7 January 1997," it aid.
"HIH Winterthur Insurance and the Colonial Group are entering into a strategic alliance under which all Colonial General insurance products will be underwritten by HIH Winterthur Insurance."

HIH Winterthur said it would also be providing home and contents insurance through the National Australia Bank Ltd in a separate initiative that is expected to generate at least A$70 million to A$100 million of premium in its first two years.

"For many years now, the hallmark of our company has been strategically building profitable growth. Clearly 1997 will continue that solid record," HIH Winterthur chief executive Ray Williams said in a statement.
"HIH Winterthur is now clearly entrenched as the Australian market leader in the provision of general insurance products through banks and other financial institutions," Williams said.
Colonial staff currently working in Colonial General would be offered employment with HIH Winterthur Insurance.
HIH Winterhur said it expected substantial organic growth from this segment of HIH Winterthur's portfolio.
On Monday it announced it had bought back CareAmerica Compensation and Liability Insurance Co, a unit of Care America, for US$59 million.
HIH set up the workers compensation unit, formerly known as Health Cal, in 1987 and then sold it in 1994 for US$93 million.
HIH Winterthur's shares closed down five cents at A$3.25 on Tuesday. The company is 48 percent-controlled by Winterthur Swiss.
